about: GOLDEN-VENUE fixtures: stored 1-minute candles exported read-only from the venue hub (python -m sleeve_fund.history export, via the golden-export workflow), with the canon backfill's replacement records for the same window. Each file is listed with the sha256 of its decompressed CSV; tests/test_golden_manifest.py is red if any candle changes or a file is added or removed without updating this list. Only change it with the Data Architect and Head of QA's sign-off.
